evals.prompt:
Finish the infrahub-sync config that syncs our NetBox sites and devices into
Infrahub. We use the netbox adapter that ships with infrahub-sync. Our schema is
fixed and already loaded:

```yaml
version: "1.0"
generics:
  - name: GenericDevice
    namespace: Dcim
    human_friendly_id: [name__value, location__name__value]
    attributes:
      - {name: name, kind: Text}
      - {name: description, kind: Text, optional: true}
    relationships:
      - {name: location, peer: LocationSite, cardinality: one, optional: false}
  - name: GenericEndpoint
    namespace: Dcim
    attributes:
      - {name: address, kind: IPHost, optional: true}
nodes:
  - name: Site
    namespace: Location
    human_friendly_id: [name__value]
    attributes:
      - {name: name, kind: Text, unique: true}
      - {name: description, kind: Text, optional: true}
      - {name: netbox_id, kind: Number, optional: true}
  - name: Device
    namespace: Network
    inherit_from: [DcimGenericDevice, DcimGenericEndpoint]
    attributes:
      - {name: serial_number, kind: Text, optional: true}
      - {name: netbox_id, kind: Number, optional: true}
```

My draft config:

```yaml
name: from-netbox
source:
  name: netbox
  settings:
    url: "https://netbox.example.com"
destination:
  name: infrahub
  settings:
    url: "http://localhost:8000"
schema_mapping:
  - name: LocationSite
    mapping: dcim.sites
    identifiers: [name]
    fields:
      - {name: name, mapping: name}
      - {name: description, mapping: description}
  - name: NetworkDevice
    mapping: dcim.devices
    identifiers: [netbox_id]
    fields:
      - {name: netbox_id, mapping: id}
      - {name: name, mapping: name}
      - {name: location, mapping: site, reference: LocationSite}
```

We key devices on the NetBox `id` because the network team renames devices
regularly and the NetBox id never changes. The device mapping still needs the
serial number and the primary IP address, and the sites should carry their
NetBox id too.

Save the complete config to: config.yml
evals.expected_output: A config whose NetworkDevice identifiers are name and location, matching the human_friendly_id [name__value, location__name__value] inherited from DcimGenericDevice, so the Infrahub upsert cannot merge two devices that share a name and a site. netbox_id stays an ordinary field.
expectations: NetworkDevice identifiers are name and location
netbox_id is mapped as a field, not used as an identifier

assertions.name: identifiers-match-hfid
assertions.check: Each mapping's identifiers equal the fields of the destination kind's human_friendly_id
